limitations: Trellis35 W4A8 Target and mixed NVFP4/FP8/BF16 Assistant versus official Google QAT Q4_0 Target and separate Unsloth Q4 GGUF Assistant; quality equivalence is not established.
gem16 checkpoint FP8 K/V versus llama.cpp Q8_0 K/V; no precision or format fallback.
Text-only engine comparison; Vision modules are not loaded.
Model load and initial plan/graph creation are outside inference metrics; process lifecycles differ as disclosed.
Prefill/TTFT use engine timing including first-token selection; server and CLI orchestration boundaries are not identical.
Decode throughput uses 1134 post-first-token intervals in both engines; aggregate ITL is not a per-token percentile distribution.
Peak VRAM is device-wide NVML sampling at 200 ms, not an instrumented allocation maximum.
D2 proposals are not output tokens; ordinary/D2 identity and counters are reported separately.

Trellis35 D2 fails before inference: initial full-case warmup and both default/EAGER eight-token probes return SIGSEGV. No D2 replacement, graph bypass, precision fallback or runtime-source change was made.
No broad quality suite or Windows measurement was run.
